CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.guard_baseline_activation_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.baseline_blueprint_activation current_pointer
        WHERE current_pointer.organization_id = NEW.organization_id AND current_pointer.occupation_id = NEW.occupation_id
          AND current_pointer.activation_revision = NEW.activation_revision AND current_pointer.blueprint_id = NEW.blueprint_id
          AND current_pointer.blueprint_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.blueprint_version
          AND current_pointer.activated_by = NEW.actor_id AND current_pointer.activated_at = NEW.occurred_at) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Activation event must describe the current transaction pointer' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.guard_irt_effective_selection()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Effective selection history cannot be deleted' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        IF NEW.selection_revision <> 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'First selection revision must be one' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;
    ELSIF NEW.organization_id <> OLD.organization_id OR NEW.question_bank_id <> OLD.question_bank_id
        OR NEW.model_version_id <> OLD.model_version_id OR NEW.selection_revision <> OLD.selection_revision + 1
        OR NEW.parameter_set_id = OLD.parameter_set_id OR NEW.selected_at <= OLD.selected_at THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Selection requires stable scope, a new set and next revision' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM platform.irt_parameter_set s
        JOIN platform.irt_calibration_run r ON r.output_parameter_set_id=s.parameter_set_id AND r.model_version_id=s.model_version_id
        JOIN platform.model_version m ON m.model_version_id=s.model_version_id
        JOIN platform.question_bank b ON b.question_bank_id=NEW.question_bank_id
        JOIN platform.account owner ON owner.account_id=b.created_by
        JOIN platform.organization o ON o.organization_id=owner.organization_id
        WHERE s.parameter_set_id=NEW.parameter_set_id AND s.model_version_id=NEW.model_version_id
          AND s.status='PROMOTED' AND s.source='CALIBRATED' AND s.activated_by=NEW.selected_by AND s.activated_at=NEW.selected_at
          AND r.status='SUCCEEDED' AND r.configuration->>'origin'='ACTUAL_PILOT'
          AND r.diagnostics->'result'->>'origin'='ACTUAL_PILOT'
          AND r.configuration->'request'->'scope'->>'organizationId'=NEW.organization_id::text
          AND r.configuration->'request'->'scope'->>'bankId'=NEW.question_bank_id::text
          AND m.approved_by IS NOT NULL AND m.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND m.algorithm='IRT_3PL'
          AND owner.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND owner.active AND o.status='ACTIVE'
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Scoped approved actual-pilot promotion required' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.valid_baseline_option_order(options jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
AS $function$
    SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(options) = 'array' THEN
        jsonb_array_length(options) >= 2
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(options) option
            WHERE jsonb_typeof(option) <> 'string' OR btrim(option #>> '{}') = '')
        AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT option) = count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(options) option)
    ELSE false END
$function$

        WHERE blueprint_id = NEW.blueprint_id AND blueprint_version = NEW.version)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.baseline_adaptive_blueprint_role role
            WHERE role.blueprint_id = NEW.blueprint_id AND role.blueprint_version = NEW.version
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.baseline_adaptive_blueprint_skill skill
                WHERE skill.blueprint_id = role.blueprint_id AND skill.blueprint_version = role.blueprint_version
                  AND skill.role_id = role.role_id))
        OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.baseline_blueprint_activation_event
            WHERE blueprint_id = NEW.blueprint_id AND blueprint_version = NEW.version AND operation = 'FINALIZE') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Finalization requires roles, skills and an activation event' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.validate_assessment_item_generation_context()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    definition record;
BEGIN
    SELECT purpose, blueprint_id, blueprint_version
    INTO definition
    FROM platform.assessment_version
    WHERE assessment_version_id = NEW.assessment_version_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    IF definition.blueprint_id IS NULL THEN
        IF NEW.role_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.scoring_weight <= 0 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Legacy and module assessment items require positive weight and no blueprint role'
                USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    IF definition.purpose <> 'BASELINE'
        OR NEW.role_id IS NULL
        OR NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM platform.baseline_blueprint_role role
            JOIN platform.baseline_blueprint_skill skill
              ON skill.blueprint_id = role.blueprint_id
             AND skill.blueprint_version = role.blueprint_version
             AND skill.role_id = role.role_id
            JOIN platform.item_version item
              ON item.item_version_id = NEW.item_version_id
             AND item.micro_skill_id = skill.micro_skill_id
            WHERE role.blueprint_id = definition.blueprint_id
              AND role.blueprint_version = definition.blueprint_version
              AND role.role_id = NEW.role_id
              AND role.role_name_snapshot = NEW.role_name_snapshot
              AND role.enabled
        ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Generated assessment item does not match its pinned blueprint role and skill'
            USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.validate_baseline_activation_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.baseline_blueprint_activation_event event
        WHERE event.organization_id = NEW.organization_id AND event.occupation_id = NEW.occupation_id
          AND event.activation_revision = NEW.activation_revision AND event.blueprint_id = NEW.blueprint_id
          AND event.blueprint_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.blueprint_version
          AND event.actor_id = NEW.activated_by AND event.occurred_at = NEW.activated_at) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Activation requires matching append-only audit event' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.validate_baseline_blueprint_role_total()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    expected_total integer;
    configured_total bigint;
BEGIN
    SELECT role.total_question_count
    INTO expected_total
    FROM platform.baseline_blueprint_role role
    WHERE role.blueprint_id = NEW.blueprint_id
      AND role.blueprint_version = NEW.blueprint_version
      AND role.role_id = NEW.role_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Blueprint role is missing while validating configured total'
            USING ERRCODE = '23503';
    END IF;

    SELECT coalesce(sum(
        skill.easy_question_count::bigint
        + skill.medium_question_count::bigint
        + skill.hard_question_count::bigint), 0)
    INTO configured_total
    FROM platform.baseline_blueprint_skill skill
    WHERE skill.blueprint_id = NEW.blueprint_id
      AND skill.blueprint_version = NEW.blueprint_version
      AND skill.role_id = NEW.role_id;

    IF expected_total <> configured_total THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Blueprint role total % does not match configured skill total %',
            expected_total, configured_total
            USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform.validate_completion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.activity_requirement WHERE activity_id = NEW.activity_id AND required)
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM platform.activity_requirement requirement
            WHERE requirement.activity_id = NEW.activity_id AND requirement.required
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.completion_pass accepted_pass
                WHERE accepted_pass.activity_id = requirement.activity_id
                AND accepted_pass.assessment_version_id = requirement.assessment_version_id)
        ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Completion requires every required assessment pass in this activity' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
